title: Inherited Traits
seo_title: Grade 3 Inherited Traits Worksheets: Traits from Parents and Variation
standard_text: Analyze and interpret data to provide evidence that plants and animals have traits inherited from parents and that variation of these traits exists in a group of similar organisms.
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 science worksheets on inherited traits (NGSS 3-LS3-1): traits passed from parents to offspring, variation among siblings, and inherited vs. learned traits in plants and animals. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Offspring inherit traits from their parents.
key_sub: Young plants and animals look like their parents, but not exactly. Learned skills and injuries are not inherited.
body_html:
How to think about it

A trait is a feature of a living thing. Many traits are inherited: they are passed from parents to their offspring. Eye color, fur color, ear shape, leaf shape and flower color are inherited.

Offspring look like their parents but are not exactly the same. Even brothers and sisters are a little different. This is called variation.

Some traits are not inherited: skills we learn (riding a bike) and changes from the environment (a scar or a sunburn).

Example

A black dog and a brown dog have puppies. What color will the puppies most likely be?

Puppies inherit traits from their parents.

Answer: black, brown or a mix

Example

Is speaking English inherited?

It must be learned.

Answer: No, it is learned.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking learned skills are inherited.
  • Thinking offspring are exact copies of their parents.
  • Thinking a scar or injury is passed to the young.

items.q: Do plants inherit traits?
c: Yes. Seeds grow into plants with traits like their parent plants.
items.e: A sunflower seed grows into a sunflower.
